subject: Can I combine R.I.L. and F2 with c.cross?

messages.author: 6d1dcf35235d1ecd
messages.subject: Can I combine R.I.L. and F2 with c.cross?
parts:
Group

I am looking at the possibility of taking two under-powered studies: (55 BXD recombinant inbred mouse lines) and a [B6XDBA] F2 cohort (around 120 mice) for which I have dense genotype data (MUGA data for BXD, MegaMuga for F2).  I have found more complex ways to do this in the literature (probably beyond our means) but now recall a c.cross function in Rqtl.  Can this be used to combine Backcross (BXD) and intercross (F2) datasets?

thanks for the insight.

Bruce

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Can I combine R.I.L. and F2 with c.cross?
parts:
The function c.cross() currently works only to combine crosses of the same type (e.g., both F2), or to combine backcrosses and intercrosses.

The simplest approach to combine the two studies would be to just add the LOD curves.

karl
